cost: Scalar O(k) callbacks; dense quadratic O(k*n²), Lasso O(k*m*n) plus objective/residual checks; leaf dimensions and iteration caps apply.
description: Bounded scalar minimization and sufficient-decrease search, box/simplex quadratic optimization, and coordinate Lasso descent.
forward: Bounded scalar minimization and sufficient-decrease search, box/simplex quadratic optimization, and coordinate Lasso descent.

Directional quadratic restrictions connect Armijo to Brent; QR normal equations connect least squares to constrained optimization on fixtures with feasible minimizer; orthogonal Lasso reduces to soft threshold.
inverse: For real convex quadratic minimization on C, exclude infeasible x or b-Q*x outside N_C(x); for Lasso exclude Aᵀ(A*x-y)+lambda*s!=0 for every s in the L1 subgradient. For a supplied scalar restriction, exclude an Armijo step violating its sufficient-decrease inequality and a claimed global Brent minimizer outside the stipulated unimodal target. Native finite reports instead obey rounded transition/stopping relations: box projected-step residual, simplex FW gap and Lasso KKT residual are distinct. Exclude switching the minus-linear convention, using objective error as coordinate error, exceeding callback budget or relabeling exhausted/stagnated reports. Native Converged does not assert the exact real KKT equalities.

For fixed real Q,C and feasible optimizer x, compatible linear terms lie in Q*x+N_C(x); thus a boundary optimizer generally does not identify b. Identity-design Lasso with lambda fixed gives y_i=x_i+lambda*sign(x_i) for nonzero x_i, while x_i=0 admits every y_i in [-lambda,lambda]. General designs admit y with Aᵀ(y-A*x) in lambda*partial||x||1, including null(Aᵀ) perturbations. Brent and Armijo observations retain many callbacks agreeing at the sampled points but differing elsewhere; a step does not recover its direction or original objective. These are real target fibers; matching a native report additionally requires matching its rounded path, validation and status.
limitations: Scalar unimodality/differentiability are caller premises. Projected step residual and FW floating gap are not unconditional distance/certified objective bounds. Tightened PSD admission rejects some valid PSD matrices.
Finite tests and source-derived models are not a universal proof.
state: Quadratic objective is .5*xQx-linear*x; Lasso is .5||Ax-y||²+lambda||x||1. Scalar bracket, feasible set, stationarity measure and termination status remain tagged.
